entities.definition: Read-only EV input-power estimate from state-qualified actual current times commissioned voltage and phases. Not requested current, charger maximum or a revenue-grade measurement. Zero when no EV is configured or a fresh explicit non-charging state is observed; unknown is not zero.
entities.producer: SiteReadModel via split_house_ev_load and native mapped EV observations
entities.time_basis: Fresh non-restored charging-state report; actual current is a retained provider value. Commissioned voltage is an estimate, not live voltage.
entities.availability: Coordinator healthy and qualified numeric projection; missing, restored, future or invalid evidence is unavailable

entities.definition: Read-only house consumption excluding EV exactly once. Sensor topology uses its saved includes-EV flag; an explicitly selected whole-site power balance necessarily includes EV. Negative source or subtraction is invalid, not absolute value or zero.
entities.producer: SiteReadModel via split_house_ev_load and canonical house telemetry
entities.time_basis: Current canonical house sample and state-qualified EV estimate; opt-in cloud-solar balance has a separately bounded solar age
entities.availability: Coordinator healthy and qualified numeric projection; includes-EV source needs qualified EV evidence

fleet_summary_v1.ev_charging_power_kw: Read-only EV input-power estimate from qualified actual current, commissioned voltage and phases. Null means unknown, not stopped. Zero for a non-EV site. Does not grant command authority.
fleet_summary_v1.house_load_excluding_ev_kw: Read-only house-only estimate after topology-qualified EV subtraction exactly once. Null for invalid negative data, unavailable dependencies or impossible subtraction. Retained house_load_kw keeps its previous mapped-topology meaning.
fleet_summary_v1.load_power_reason: Qualification of the house/EV split or canonical house-source failure. Raw invalid inputs and original source timestamps remain in existing telemetry diagnostics; no absolute-value or zero-clamp repair.
